title: More Recipes
description: This data pack adds tons of recipes for vanilla items.
body:
## More Recipes
More Recipes is a datapack which adds recipes for many uncraftable vanilla items.
It includes recipes for:
- Horse Armor
- Tridents
- Elytra
- Totems of Undying
- Netherite Upgrade Smithing Templates
- Name Tags
- Music Discs
- Mob Heads
- And tons of other items!

Here are some of the recipes:

### Trident
3 Prismarine Shards + 2 Diamonds

### Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template
1 Diamond Block + 8 Nether Bricks

### Horse Armor
7 of the material the horse armor is made of

### Totem of Undying
4 Gold Ingots + 1 Gold Block + 2 Emerald Blocks

### Skeleton Skull
1 Bone Block + 8 Bones
All the other heads are based on the Skeleton Skull.

### 9 Nether Wart
1 Nether Wart Block

There are also other recipes I didn't show in this description, but most of them are pretty easy to unlock and add to your recipe book.
It is meant to be used in a survival playthrough to make some items easier to get.
That's all I can say about it, so just get it!
